fields.description: Mirrors the listing's `listing_category` — an existing Shopify Category name.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: Mirrors the listing's `listing_product_type` — the specific noun for what the product is.
fields.label: Product Type

fields.description: Mirrors the listing's `listing_seo_title` — the search-result snippet title, distinct from Title above.
fields.label: SEO Title

fields.description: Mirrors the listing's `listing_seo_description` — the search-result snippet description, capped at 320 characters.
fields.label: SEO Description

fields.description: One tag per line. Published to the Item's Shopify tag list (Item.sh_shopify_tags) on approval, self-healing any Shopify Tag master that does not exist locally yet.
fields.label: Shopify Tags

fields.description: Structured product attributes. These become the listing's Shopify metafields (namespace `custom`) on approval, so edit them here before approving.
fields.label: Attributes

fields.description: The attributes exactly as the agent returned them, kept for audit. The Attributes table is what gets published — editing this changes nothing.
fields.label: Attributes (JSON)

fields.description: Images are produced after the listing text is saved, so a listing can be ready to review while its imagery is still rendering.
fields.label: Image Status
fields.options:
Not Required
Queued
Running
Ready
Partial
Failed

fields.description: Tokens the image service billed for this listing. Recorded here rather than on the run, because the imagery is produced after the run closes.
fields.label: Image Tokens

fields.description: Thumbnails of what the image step produced; the child table below is always the editable source.
fields.label: Image Preview

fields.description: Images this run produced. Source photos are never overwritten.
fields.label: Images

fields.description: What the agent observed per variant — option values read from its own photo and text, and suggestions where they disagree with the catalog. Review material only: nothing here is pushed on approval, and the agent never renames a variant. Variant images live in the Images table above, tagged with their variant.
fields.label: Variants

fields.description: Fields the agent could not confidently fill — complete these before approving.
fields.label: Needs Review

fields.description: The per-variant observations exactly as the agent returned them, kept for audit. The Variants table is the readable copy.
fields.label: Variants (JSON)

fields.description: Verbatim JSON returned by the agent, kept for audit.
fields.label: Raw Agent Output (JSON)
